name: Student Intern Program
what_you_do: You join a county tech team for the summer. You help build apps and tools for the County. You may work on apps, websites, tech help, networks, security or servers.
grades: High school, college or STEM trade school students
who_can_apply: High school, college and STEM trade school students. The program page does not list an age or residency rule.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: Applications for Cohort 2026 are closed. The program page says it will post more information in February or March 2027.
how_to_apply: The program page does not say how to apply. Check it again in February or March 2027.
notes: The program page does not give program dates, pay or an age limit, so ask before you plan. Questions: alcoitd@acgov.org.
